moments.author: Entertainment Weekly
moments.quote: ‘Baywatch’ alum Erika Eleniak recently joined OnlyFans, and says her earnings from the platform helped prevent her from being evicted from her home: ‘I’m the one that is calling the shots.’
moments.why: It went viral due to its candid and surprising angle on OnlyFans being a financial lifeline for a former Baywatch star, flipping expectations about both the platform and celebrity finances.

moments.author: Rolling Stone
moments.quote: Taylor Swift Throws It Back at the 2026 CMAs With ‘Our Song’ The pop superstar returned to the awards ceremony stage after 13 years, alongside Keith Urban, to perform "I Knew It, I Knew You" and a bit of her 2006 hit.
